tool.name: datav-generate-dashboard
tool.description:
Generate (create) a draft dashboard with panels and dataset references from a structured specification.
Workflow: First use datav-list-datasets, datav-describe-dataset and datav-query-dataset to understand the available data, then call this tool ONCE to author the dashboard.
Creates: - A Dashboard row with publishStatus=DRAFT (version=0, not published). - One DatasetRef per unique datasetSid referenced by needsDataset=true panels (deduplicated within the dashboard; paramMapping initialized to {}). - One Panel per panels[] entry (panelName=title, panelType mapped from componentType, panelConfig.fieldMapping stores the provided fieldMapping).
Validation (failures return explicit errors, the loop will feed them back so you can correct and retry): - componentType MUST be one of the 8 dashboard types. Decorative/media types return ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_GENERATE_UNSUPPORTED_COMPONENT; truly unknown types return ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_GENERATE_UNKNOWN_COMPONENT. - For needsDataset=true components, datasetSid MUST reference an existing active (status=1) dataset that is also visible to the current user (created by the current user, or the caller is admin). A non-existent/inactive dataset returns ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_GENERATE_DATASET_NOT_FOUND; an existing active dataset that is NOT visible to the current user returns ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_DATASET_NO_ACCESS. - If fieldMapping is provided, every referenced field name MUST exist in the dataset's dsMeta field set; otherwise ERR_DATAV_CHATBI_GENERATE_INVALID_SPEC.
The generated dashboard is a DRAFT — the user must explicitly publish it via the platform publishDashboard action. You MUST NOT claim the dashboard is published.
Returns JSON with: - dashboardId: the created dashboard ID - panels: summary of created panels (panelName, componentType, datasetRefId) - datasetRefs: summary of created dataset references (datasetRefId, refDatasetId)
Safety constraints (MUST FOLLOW): - You can ONLY reference pre-registered datasets and map existing fields. You MUST NOT generate, write, or execute raw SQL. - The result is a DRAFT. Do NOT auto-publish.
